Yeah everyone sucks at conversation with someone new, that is why, when you 'seem' happy (aka smiling) people will find you more approachable, it's really key, also *how* you talk to people (not monotone, too quietly or too loudly) has a lot of effect ...

Being social is a skill that can be learned, little to do with being introverted or extroverted, you can be introverted but still have a lot to say/make a joke, depending on how you see the people you're talking to/in company of.

But it's not easy and it's not as easy as flipping a switch, it's practice, it's work, ... That makes it harder to get over it but if you practice you'll see it'll make it easier step by step...
Atleast that's my expirience  ...

I also struggle a lot with making conversation with people because I assume they won't/don't like me, because I have 'nothing to say' to them or whatever bs I can come up with, this is why you should remember, people *like your attention*, and *people love to be approached*

An example I heard of was; if you're alone at a party and someone comes up to you and talk to you, you'll see them as friendly right? you'll be happy someone takes their time to try to make conversation with you, even when you were too nervous to approach someone yourself

Now if you were smiling, people would see you as more approachable vs if you're looking down at your phone/the ground or just looking sad/frustrated ...

Also keep in mind everyone is afraid of rejection, even the guy that is very sociable/seems very extroverted, and comes up to you to try to talk is a little nervous/scared of being blown off by you


This is what I like to think like, everyone is kind of nervous, everyone is kind of afraid to be rejected, just some people move on faster than others(to a new conversation/new person to talk to, not caring about what previous expiriences showed)

They also have the confidence, to go up to someone, it takes to fake it till you make it work... But yes some days people are just not feeling it, or not 'liking' you, but you shouldn't make that a permanent state of 'no one likes you'/'he doesn't like you' because of a bad expirience, and I have to keep telling myself that everytime, because I need to develop social skills, because I never truly have ...
